(1) using step-by-step instructions from humans can be used to solve multi-task reinforcement learning problems more efficiently and (2) the resulting agent can be trained to generalize to new tasks in a zero- and few-shot learning setting.
human instructions can improve generalization and interpretability in reinforcement learning.
using human demonstrations in the forms of natural language instructions helps solve complex tasks in reinforcement learning.

the problem of how to use human demonstrations to facilitate the automatic decomposition into low-level policies and to facilitate generalization.

the following questions: (1) Can we use natural language as a tool to facilitate the automatic discovery of low-level policies? (2) Can we use language to improve sample efficiency in reinforcement learning?
the following question: How do humans solve complex tasks?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we introduce a dataset for multi-task reinforcement learning, and show that incorporating human instructions into the model allows it to generalize better and to solve complex tasks more efficiently.
the use of natural language in reinforcement learning can improve generalization and sample efficiency in complex, hierarchical tasks.
the use of natural language instruction can help reinforcement learning to generalize to unseen environments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our model is able to learn to generate natural language instructions that can be used to guide the agent to solve unseen tasks.
our model learns a hierarchical policy that is sample efficient, generalizable, interpretable, and can learn from few demonstrations.
our model is able to solve complex tasks by learning from natural language instructions, and it is able to generalize to novel tasks in a zero shot manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
natural language is a powerful tool that can help solve complex, sparse-reward tasks.
human instructions can be used to improve the generalization and sample efficiency of a reinforcement learning agent in a zero-shot, multi-task setting.
humans are a valuable resource to help reinforcement learning agents generalize to unseen tasks.
